proposed_widenings.name: reactive_passive_magic_item_component
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines an always-on passive bonus with a standing reaction rider that is not use-count- or reset-based. Current MagicItemMechanics can compose passive and activated parts, but not a trigger-shaped passive component that only spends the reaction quota when its trigger occurs.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction...

proposed_widenings.name: reduce_forced_movement
proposed_widenings.justification: The rider does not create movement; it reduces an incoming forced-movement distance by up to a cap. Existing atoms like force_move and modify_speed do not model intercepting another effect's movement payload.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_dwarven_plate.dhall. Passive modify_ac is expressible, but the forced-movement reaction rider would require both a new triggered component shape for magic items and a movement-reduction effect rather than a direct movement atom.
